name: branding-isometric-wavy-topped-soap-box-packaging-in-bright-colours
title: Isometric scattered soap boxes in purple, lime, pink, orange and yellow with wavy landscape bands
whatItIs: An isometric field of boxes on an olive backdrop, each with a layered wavy landscape band in a flavour colour (purple berry, green pear, pink apricot, orange, yellow), a small logo, flavour names and back panels with about text and barcodes.
whatItMeans: Fresh and organised; each flavour has its own colourway on one template.
techniques: Use layered wavy bands as the graphic.

vocabulary.definition: A colour scheme assigned to a variant.
A layered wave graphic on packaging.
The rear pack side with info and barcode.
